stages.prompt: Run python3 scripts/content/pipeline.py plan content/<content-id> and python3 scripts/estimate_project.py content/<content-id> (no network). Report which shots are ready and what is missing.
Ask the user for one clean vertical still per generated shot (from ChatGPT). Upload each with scripts/upload_reference.py and record the HTTPS URL in the shot request. Never upload a collage.

Run python3 scripts/list_video_models.py, then python3 scripts/estimate_project.py content/<content-id> --estimate. Present model, duration, resolution, 9:16, audio setting (estimate audio on and off if undecided), exact prompts, per-shot and total cost. Do not submit.
State the quoted configuration and total cost and wait. Do not generate until the user explicitly approves that exact quote.

PAID. Only after approval: run scripts/generate_video.py --request <request> --wait for the single approved shot. Record request ID and local path. On timeout or error, check scripts/request_status.py first; never resubmit blindly.
Extract the actual terminal frame of the accepted shot and use it as the next shot's first frame. If a shot is rejected, stop the chain and reapprove before continuing.
